summary: Opaque native addon with browser-credential and host-fingerprint capability, no publisher metadata
details: Package ships a single ~10 MB prebuilt Rust N-API addon (linux-x64-gnu) with a two-line README and no source. Extracted binary strings include browser-credential store markers ('Found login for', 'on Cookie.value when inserting', 'TSQLITE_AUTH_USER'), host-fingerprint paths ('/dev/disk/by-id/', 'network_adapters'), and symbols for gethostname, getifaddrs, posix_spawnp/execvp, a linked HTTPS client (rustls + ureq), and Zip archive writing — the capability profile of a browser login/cookie stealer with network exfil and packaging. package.json declares no author, repository, homepage, or description; the name is generic ('new-native-tools-linux-x64-gnu') and the version string embeds a Unix-ms-shaped timestamp ('3.1.40-as2-9962-369-1784812980'). No install lifecycle hooks are declared, so the addon executes when a consuming package require()s it or invokes its N-API exports rather than at npm install; no first-party publisher, documentation, or legitimate use case is identifiable for a binary with this capability set.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
